standard_prerequisites: Original cited global Kuranishi-chart existence/equivalence, ordinary Thom/Gysin/localisation/compactness and gluing facts; current author appendices retained. No recursive re-proof of external prerequisites.
core_obligations: H3: For the Gromov-Witten classes defined by the cited global Kuranishi construction, prove the complete Kontsevich-Manin CohFT axioms. Given existence/equivalence of global charts, Thom and Gysin facts, the remaining geometric work compares charts under forgetful and nodal clutching maps, factors the non-cartesian clutching diagram through a degree-one birational map on quotient presentations, and establishes the matching exceptional-pushforward/virtual-class relations including nonseparating genus reduction and orbifold intersections. This is one complete CohFT framework; individual axioms, standard descendants and technical chart lemmas are not independent new counts.
